name: Arnolt Arfa Nugraha
hero_intro: A Software and Game Development (PPLG) student at SMK Telkom Purwokerto who designs, builds, and ships websites, apps, and games.
hero_side: From the first sketch in Figma to a live site on a real domain, every project is shaped to be clear, useful, and ready for people to use.
statement: Student by day, builder by habit. I design, build, and ship
about: Hi, I'm Arnolt Arfa Nugraha, you can call me Arnolt. I'm a Software and Game Development (PPLG) student at SMK Telkom Purwokerto with a passion for technology, design, and building websites that help businesses grow.

I used to run Avtrade Game, a small business buying and selling game accounts, which taught me management, customer service, and marketing. Today I put that experience into building websites for businesses, like Windiarto and Baru Raya Toys, from the first idea to a live site on the client's own domain.
closing: Good products start with good questions. Design gives them form, code gives them life,
closing_muted: and care for detail makes them last.
contact_text: Need a website for your business, or have a project or internship in mind? From a simple company profile to an online store with an admin dashboard, I'm happy to help turn it into reality.
